pr_title: Sms 242-b apply frontend changes to preview and report, sync back end to send me

comments.body: Can you fix `Nonbranded` to `NonBranded` while you are at it please.

ReactNodeArray should have `key` props for each entry. 
Eslint will probably complain in the future. 
I suggest changing this to 
```
<React.Fragment>
    {messagePrefix}: {renderedMessage}
</React.Fragment>
```
